verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a general documented public API: probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. The only programmatic surface is the official Superhuman Mail MCP server, which lets AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT read, draft and send email and schedule meetings, and is framed as a way to 'drive Superhuman Mail' from AI tools. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API with reference docs or a spec, developer auth/rate-limit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP interface.
